CommunityApplications.Profile:
Docker templates for self-hosted applications: **Immich** (photo and video management), **Hermes Agent** (self-improving AI assistant), **Vibe Kanban** (AI-first project management), **PhotoMigrator** (photo service migration), and **WGER** (fitness tracker and workout manager).
Each multi-container stack includes all required components (database, cache, workers, proxy).
For issues, open a ticket at https://github.com/rorar/unraid-templates/issues
